Name: Cherry Blossom UI
Author: justaslime1
Description:
Hi! This is my first time posting to Nexus, but pretty much my first mod ever. I made this for personal use cause I wanted a pink UI and couldn't find one I liked, so I made it myself. I was encouraged to post it, so here it is!

Now, this mod changes the title screen (not really animated[i] yet, [/i]but I will work on it), as well as the inventory screen, tabs, the clock, the dialogue boxes and portraits, and icons here and there, to be pink like cherry blossoms. 

If you see anything to change, or be included in this mod, please let me know as I am sure I missed quite a bit. I really hope you like it!!
